A13, P05 -> P16, order, fair: an instantiate line shows A13 when its concepts show upkeep or defence of the room's own work (G11, with G36's readings) and, after it, help given, offered, asked for, received or traded with another room (G17); classed by the first act of each. Readings from the arrow's words: the second end is help passing (not greetings, compliments, condolences, an alliance as such, terms not about help, a call to own members, or a proposal to ask with no request made; thanks count where the thanked help can be placed after the upkeep); the first end is the room's own upkeep, and where the first upkeep shown is itself another room's helpers the two ends are one act (J); the direction of the first help (asks or receives, gives or offers, traded) is recorded for the census. Rejected: help before any upkeep, split into the bound's pattern (helping a neighbour or coming as a helper before having a work) and the counterexample response's second path (help asked or received to start or build, or traded for space, before any upkeep); J; one end; not help; another room's upkeep or help first after hour 73. Absent lines by G2 and G3; restrict and add lines by G9 and G4a with the statements named; the falsifier's second clause read inside the rooms carrying both (held by P05's hand upkeep, A06 and P14, K02, P10 and A10, P16's refusals). Lines the concepts do not support as the order are drawn, so the packet is read whole, as every A13 packet is, each line with its concepts quoted and its reply context (d3_read_window.py)

G45's readings, stated while ruling the instantiate lines and logged before any is written (they read G45 and change no ruling rule): (1) the first end from the room's record: a coded upkeep post by the room's members above the line's concepts in their reply chain (the submission or a parent) can be the first end; the reason names it and the census marks it R, as G44 reading 1 did; (2) the order in words (M): a request for help, or a post answered in reply by help, that names an attack, damage, a loss or the strain of keeping the room's own work, present or announced, shows the order in words, since naming the attack is G11's watching and the help answers it, in either word order (G38's reading); help placed after the upkeep only by the hours or the thread is the order by the hours (O); (3) help to another room: the room helping another room after its own upkeep shows the order with direction gives (O-OUT); the other room's strain is not the mechanism in words, which names the room's own work; where the room's own upkeep is not shown, the line shows one end; (4) a request reaching the room is the second end at its hour; where the room's upkeep is shown only as already under way at a later hour, the first acts cannot be ordered (J, giivasunner, placetardis), as G38 read reports; (5) trades for night cover: help or space given now so that another room keeps the work while members sleep makes the room's first upkeep shown the helpers' watch, one act (J); those naming the night shortage are marked JM, as A06's census marked JM (australia, ockytop, sweden); (6) a visitor's defence or repair coming before any upkeep by the room's members is J (afip, brasil, japan, AprilKnights, pakistan's r/India helpers); (7) a line whose only help is named as help to start or build, with no upkeep shown, is the second path (SP: singapore, 2007scape); other help-only lines are one end; (8) an upkeep in a post with no code cannot be the first end, as G44 reading 4 read uncoded first parts (AmericanFlaginPlace, babymetal, rangers, texans); (9) upkeep followed only by proposals to ask or plans to help inside the room is NH (G17's readings); A13's support transition aceattorney-044 is such a proposal, as G36 found A04's to be; (10) a NONPORTABLE line is a particular by G6 and the census counts the order it shows apart (PO, detroitredwings-036)
